page: Microsoft Azure M96bds_2_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C x86_64 processor clocked at 4.0 GHz, offering 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 48 physical cores with two threads per core. The processor features 105 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and AMX matrix accelerators. The instance is configured with 1946.0 GB of RAM, equating to approximately 20.27 GB per vCPU. Storage includes 4832 GB of local SSD capacity alongside support for Azure Premium Storage. It contains no dedicated GPU hardware accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional multi-threaded performance and memory throughput. The server scores in the top tier for multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 559.33 GB/sec and uncached large-block memory read bandwidth at 429.2 GB/sec. Overall PassMark CPU performance is high at 97,234.14 points, backed by strong extended instruction capabilities. In database evaluations, PassMark database operations reached the top 10% tier with 35,122.57 operations, while Redis recorded 114.97 million SET operations per second. CPU-based LLM inference achieves solid results via AMX, yielding 33.37 prompt tokens per second and 4.93 generation tokens per second on 70B parameter models.

Given its massive memory footprint, high-core count, and 4832 GB local SSD tier, this server provides high resource density for enterprise-grade applications. It is tailored for large in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, high-throughput relational database management systems, big data analytics engines, and large-scale data caching layers.

The instance is provisioned with 1946.0 GB of system memory, providing over 20 GB of RAM per vCPU, and is equipped with 4832 GB of local SSD storage. It includes architectural support for AVX-512 and Intel AMX, but lacks dedicated GPU hardware. Benchmark results confirm strong memory and compute density, highlighted by 429.2 GB/sec uncached large-block read bandwidth, top-tier PassMark database scores of 35,122.57, and 114.97 million Redis SET operations per second. With extensive local storage and substantial RAM, the M96bds_2_v3 is best fitted for heavy in-memory enterprise databases, extensive data caching, large-scale analytics, and high-concurrency transactional processing.
